attempts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE state = 'active'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS tombstoned_claims,
       AVG(confidence) AS avg_confidence
FROM knowledge_claims
WHERE tombstone = 1

SELECT topic, fact
FROM knowledge
WHERE state = 'active'
ORDER BY confidence DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT origin_machine, COUNT(*) AS claims_rolled
FROM knowledge_claims
WHERE scope = 'sink'
GROUP BY origin_machine
ORDER BY claims_rolled DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_claims, SUM(CASE WHEN tombstone = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_tombstoned_claims FROM knowledge_claims

SELECT topic
FROM knowledge
WHERE state = 'active'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(
         CASE
           WHEN json_valid(provenance) AND json_type(provenance) = 'array'
             THEN json_array_length(provenance)
           ELSE LENGTH(provenance) - LENGTH(REPLACE(provenance, ',', '')) + 1
         END
       ) AS total_provenance_entries
FROM knowledge_claims
WHERE evidence_id = 'w-l2'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT topic) FROM knowledge WHERE origin_kind = 'lane'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_retire_proposals, MAX(score) AS highest_score
FROM knowledge_proposals
WHERE state = 'open' AND kind = 'retire'

SELECT claim, confidence
FROM knowledge_claims
WHERE evidence_id = 'w-l1' AND tombstone = 0
ORDER BY confidence DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS knowledge_count
FROM knowledge
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY knowledge_count DESC

SELECT kc.version,
       kc.confidence,
       k.topic
FROM knowledge_claims kc
JOIN knowledge k
  ON k.id = CAST(TRIM(kc.evidence_id, 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-') AS INTEGER)
WHERE kc.evidence_id = 'w-l1'
ORDER BY kc.version
